### Checklist

- [ ] Update changelog in CHANGELOG.md.
- [ ] Make sure `values.yaml` and `values.schema.json` are valid.
- [ ] A new or materially changed serving preset states its `kubernetes-cka-v2` mean score and range and links the committed result ([docs/serving-presets.md](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/blob/main/docs/serving-presets.md#the-benchmark)).
